While on a trip to Oaxaca, Mexico this year, photographer Brendan George Ko visited a family in the countryside that produces wool rugs and chocolate. Curious about the cows whose milk is used in the family’s chocolate, Ko wandered over to see them when one approached, licking his hand before standing for this photo. "It was the most peaceful moment I had," he says. "Each time I look at her portrait, I am reminded of the tranquility of Santa Cecilia," a small town outside of Oaxaca.

The Wrede passage (Finnish: Wreden pasaasi. Swedish: Wredes passage; also known as the "Old merchant alley", Finnish: Vanha kauppakuja, or the "Grandma tunnel", Finnish: Mummotunneli) is an entity formed by two stone buildings in Kluuvi, Helsinki, Finland
